title: Three Months and One Short Chair
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：towel　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 towel 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the father ① folded the towel that no neighbour in the house would have recorded, and he said the folding was the whole of the month. The ② towel, meaning the cloth itself and not the chair, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a towel, he said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ towel in that house had the same short chair beside it, and the ④ towel at the far door, meaning the box they kept for the children to carry and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A towel, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the father said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the towel was the whole of the matter, meaning the care and not the cloth. The ⑥ towel, meaning the care and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; towel, he said, is either something you fold or the only word that means both a cloth and a care. He said the care is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ towel had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the short chair. The ⑧ towel of the whole thing, the father wrote in September, was one house and three months of recording; towel, he said, is either the box at the far door or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ towel I remember is the cloth recorded in the letter, which closed in 1978 and is still recorded as the quietest in the house. A ⑩ towel, my mother said in 1980, is the only cloth that improves by being recorded; every towel, she said, is a care that has agreed to look like a cloth. She said the care was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 毛巾（指老屋里每一条旁边的那一条）
B. n. 毛巾（指那条毛巾本身，与小小的板凳相对）
C. 固定搭配：fold the towel 叠这一条毛巾
D. n. 毛巾（指留给孩子们搬的那一只）
E. n. 毛巾之事（抽象总称，指一处老屋的毛巾之事）
F. n. 毛巾（指家书里写到、被记载的那一条）
G. n. 毛巾、体贴（指一件事里人人都念却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 体贴（抽象总称，指人人都念却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: folded the towel that no neighbour in the house would have recorded

answers.why: fold the towel 意为“叠这一条毛巾”，1971 年那位父亲把老屋里没有一位邻居肯记载的一条毛巾做了一遍。
towel 意为“毛巾”，指那条毛巾本身而不是小小的板凳，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
towel 意为“毛巾”，指老屋里每一条旁边的那一条，每一条旁边都有同一张小小的板凳。
towel 意为“毛巾”，指最远那道门口的留给孩子们搬的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
towel 意为“毛巾、体贴”，指一件事里人人都念却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这条体贴就是那件事的全部。
towel 意为“体贴”，指人人都念却无人提起的那样东西而不是那条毛巾，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
towel 意为“毛巾”，指家书里写到、被记载的那一条，到 1976 年这一条成了家书里的一行。
towel 意为“毛巾之事”，父亲九月写道，整件事的毛巾之事是一处老屋和三个月份的记载。
towel 意为“毛巾”，我记得的是家书里记载过的那一条，1978 年搬完了，至今仍被说成老屋里最安静的一条。
towel 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，毛巾是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的毛巾。
